column1: # Stage B of the refactor program (#2062): where each item of src/cli.rs goes.
# One row per item, in file order. pr 0 means the item stays in cli.rs; the others
# move to src/cli/<file>.rs in that PR. kind, impl and name are as
# `scripts/move_items.py --target cli --check` after adding an item to cli.rs.
# cli.rs keeps the clap root, Cli, whose fields every subcommand's code reads.
